market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI futures April 2026 range was approximately $94 (low) to above $110 (high). Currently around $96 on April 27 with Hormuz tensions providing a floor. Hitting $90 in remaining 3 trading days requires a ~6%+ drop on de-escalation news. Possible but unlikely given persistent geopolitical bid.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden Iran ceasefire / sanctions relief news could trigger sharp drop intraday.
